summary: Frontend-only regression executed on public preview URL. Core product modal stability, bag variant merge/split, quantity bounds, persistence, deep-link, carat controls, and major footer links passed. Some flows remain partially validated due repeated selector/run instability constraints.

ui_bugs.issue: Privacy/Terms buttons did not reliably open Info dialog in repeated desktop automation attempts, while Care/Delivery did open reliably.

Repeated Playwright click attempts on remove-item controls reported 'Element is outside of viewport' despite visible controls; could not complete deterministic remove-to-empty using normal click path.

integration_issues.flow: Bag WhatsApp payload strict quantity token check
integration_issues.issue: Decoded payload includes SKU/specs/image/name/city, but strict ×2 marker assertion was not consistently captured in the final targeted run after quantity manipulations.

issues: 390/360/320 and 768 full visual regression (screenshots + overflow/scroll close gestures) remains pending from this iteration.

action_items: Investigate footer privacy/terms trigger path (event wiring/stacking/focus) and verify open behavior manually + automated.
Investigate bag remove-item click target/viewport interplay in drawer and ensure deterministic clickability.
Complete dedicated mobile/tablet regression (390/360/320/768): screenshots, overflow checks, modal/bag close interactions.
Re-validate WhatsApp bag message exact multi-line quantity markers after full lifecycle without quantity mutation side-effects.
critical_code_review_comments: App-level interaction complexity (Lenis + dialogs + multiple overlays) still creates brittle automation timing surfaces; keep deterministic ready-state guards for critical actions.
Footer legal actions require stronger e2e coverage because behavior diverges from other footer dialog actions under the same pattern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Passed in this run: product modal open reliability across 4 reloads, search->modal transition, ring variant split/merge bag lines (1->1->2->3), quantity bounds min1/max20, bag subtotal persistence across refresh, deep-link /#product-VEL-RN-101, carat slider + size tab, footer WhatsApp/mailto/boutique hrefs, care/delivery dialogs. Blocked/partial: remove-item normal click path instability, privacy/terms dialog open instability, incomplete mobile/tablet responsive verification due loop-prevention constraints after repeated selector instability.
rca of the issue: Likely interaction-layer timing/geometry issue in specific footer and drawer controls under animated SPA state (overlay/scroll/focus transitions). Reproduce by opening footer area and triggering privacy/terms repeatedly; reproduce drawer issue with populated bag and first remove control during right-drawer state. Mitigation: instrument click target hit-testing (elementFromPoint), ensure stable layout before interactions, and add explicit e2e hooks/assertions around dialog state transitions.
